sources.claim: Native map identity and independently picked architecture/perimeter targets. Its central badge occlusion is supplied by the registered original closeup.

notes: Rendered map-selection footprint only; no physical, walking, floor, accessible-entrance, route, spawn or comprehensive encounter extent claim. Full area scope remains incomplete.
